purpose: Explain Config Web AI, Config Local AI, gateways, session credentials, environment keys, model catalogs, capabilities, privacy, local base URLs, model refresh, and the Tool-versus-Project boundary.
display_lines: Config AI stores global AI connection and model settings.
Config Web AI controls gateway, credential, catalog, model, capabilities, and privacy.
Config Local AI controls the OpenAI-compatible base URL and global local model.
The active Project and exact payload remain owned by each workflow.
Config AI never grants source-writing authority.
